linearized_einstein_packets.name: radial_hessian_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Radial Hessian packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the Bianchi identity contracted with the radial null vector field L = d/dt + d/dr on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: radial_superradiant_cross_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Radial-superradiant cross packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the Bianchi identity contracted with L = d/dt + d/dr and the superradiant null vector field S = d/dt + Omega_H d/dphi on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: radial_superradiant_diagonal_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Radial-superradiant diagonal packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the Bianchi identity squared along L = d/dt + d/dr and S = d/dt + Omega_H d/dphi on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart; the c^2 sector reflects the second superradiant contraction.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: superradiant_squared_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Superradiant-squared packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the Bianchi identity contracted with S = d/dt + Omega_H d/dphi twice on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: carter_squared_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Carter-squared packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the Bianchi identity contracted with the Carter tensor factor on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart; the angular spin-weight sector of the squared Teukolsky operator.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: radial_diagonal_slack_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Radial diagonal slack packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the radial gauge-trace contraction of the Bianchi identity on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: superradiant_diagonal_slack_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Superradiant diagonal slack packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the superradiant gauge-trace contraction of the Bianchi identity on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: carter_diagonal_slack_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Carter diagonal slack packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the angular gauge-trace contraction of the Bianchi identity on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: radial_superradiant_bilinear_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Radial-superradiant bilinear packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the off-diagonal Bianchi contraction between L = d/dt + d/dr and S = d/dt + Omega_H d/dphi on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: radial_carter_bilinear_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Radial-Carter bilinear packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the off-diagonal Bianchi contraction between L = d/dt + d/dr and the Carter tensor factor on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.

linearized_einstein_packets.name: superradiant_carter_bilinear_packet
linearized_einstein_packets.provenance: Superradiant-Carter bilinear packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the off-diagonal Bianchi contraction between S = d/dt + Omega_H d/dphi and the Carter tensor factor on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart.
